Take the first derivative of the function, f'(x). Set it equal to zero and solve for x. These x-values are the potential stationary points. replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces data dimensionality by finding directions of maximum variance. First, standardize your data. Then, compute the covariance matrix. You don't need to understand all the math, just think of PCA as finding the most important patterns.
